انتفضا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَفَضَا (intafaḍā) /in.ta.fa.dˤaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# اِنْتَفِضَا (intafiḍā) /in.ta.fi.dˤaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
